name: Lovable Mobile
desc: iOS and Android app for building Lovable projects from a phone.
desc_zh: 在手机上搭建、查看 Lovable 项目的 iOS 与 Android 应用。
solves: Waiting at a desktop to answer one question about your app wastes the afternoon; the project travels with you.
solves_zh: 为了回答关于应用的一个问题而守在电脑前，一下午就没了；项目跟着你走。
best_for: You are away from your desk and a teammate needs a change shipped before the demo.
best_for_zh: 你不在电脑前，但队友需要在上演示前改一版。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — docs.lovable.dev/changelog; A — Apple App Store listing）。 Changelog entry dated May 18, 2026 announces global availability. The Apple App Store listing for Lovable carries releaseDate 2026-04-27, so a limited regional release likely preceded the global announcement; the changelog date is used as the first-party availability date. 入库核对（2026-11-25）：形态枚举没有手机应用；账本里手机应用记为 web。厂商没有公布中文名，name_zh 按 name。 首次公开日期来源：https://docs.lovable.dev/changelog
